BM25 filter works during multi-page crawl, keeping relevant pages

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Crawlberg\Crawlberg;
use Crawlberg\CrawlConfig;
$engine_config = CrawlConfig::from_json(json_encode(["bm25Query" => "rust programming", "bm25Threshold" => 0.1, "contentFilter" => "bm25", "maxConcurrent" => 1, "maxDepth" => 1]));
$engine = Crawlberg::createEngine($engine_config);
$url = "https://example.com";
$result = Crawlberg::crawl($engine, $url);
var_dump($result->getPages()[0]->html);
```
